tasks.visible_text: Create a centered four-point cyan diamond emblem on a 16x16 transparent canvas. Keep at least 3 transparent pixels of margin on every side, use at most 3 visible colors, make the complete visible shape exactly symmetric horizontally and vertically, keep it as one connected visible component, and leave no isolated visible pixels.

Create a small red health-potion bottle with a cork on a 16x16 transparent canvas. Center it, keep at least 2 transparent pixels of margin on every side, use at most 6 visible colors, make the complete visible shape vertically symmetric, keep it as one connected visible component, and leave no isolated visible pixels.

Create a gold key facing right on a 16x16 transparent canvas. Keep at least 1 transparent pixel of margin on every side, use at most 5 visible colors, keep the key as one connected visible component, and leave no isolated visible pixels.

Create a front-facing blue shield on a 16x16 transparent canvas. Center it, keep at least 2 transparent pixels of margin on every side, use at most 6 visible colors, make the complete visible shape vertically symmetric, keep it as one connected visible component, and leave no isolated visible pixels.

Create a small lantern with a warm yellow light and dark frame on a 16x16 transparent canvas. Keep at least 1 transparent pixel of margin on every side, use at most 7 visible colors, keep the lantern as one connected visible component, and leave no isolated visible pixels.

Create a front-facing wooden barrel with visible metal bands on a 16x16 transparent canvas. Center it, keep at least 1 transparent pixel of margin on every side, use at most 8 visible colors, make the complete visible shape vertically symmetric, keep it as one connected visible component, and leave no isolated visible pixels.

Create a small pine tree with a brown trunk and green canopy on a 16x16 transparent canvas. Keep at least 1 transparent pixel of margin on every side, use at most 7 visible colors, keep the tree as one connected visible component, and leave no isolated visible pixels.

information_matching.rule: Every scored method receives the exact same task visible_text and no method receives hidden_structural_constraints as prompt text. Method-specific instructions may only describe that method's frozen authoring surface and output schema.
information_matching.deterministic_feedback: After an accepted revision, both scored methods may receive the same task-applicable deterministic QA facts. TracePixel-specific stage identity is exposed only to tracepixel-staged-v1 because it is the architecture under test.

budgets.api_cost_policy: No separately metered API-key billing is permitted. The frozen provider boundary is the existing ChatGPT-authenticated Codex CLI plan; api_cost_usd_micros remains null when the provider exposes no per-call price.

retry_policy.transport_retry: At most one identical-request retry is allowed only when a provider/transport failure returns no usable proposal bytes. Both call records are retained and the retry consumes the same trial's provider-call budget.

exclusion_policy.after_provider_invocation: No scored attempt is excluded after provider invocation; provider, validation, verifier, semantic, timeout and budget failures remain failures in the result set.
exclusion_policy.pre_invocation_harness_failure: A demonstrable harness/setup failure before provider invocation may be marked void_infrastructure and rerun once with the same attempt ID plus a rerun suffix. The original record must remain retained and the reason/fix commit must be recorded.

deterministic_scoring.per_rule: Each frozen task-applicable structural rule is binary pass/fail from deterministic QA only.
deterministic_scoring.per_trial_structural_fraction: passed_applicable_rules / applicable_rules; missing or unusable final output scores 0.
deterministic_scoring.per_trial_structural_pass: true only when every applicable structural rule passes.
deterministic_scoring.completion: true only when the method returns a harness-valid final artifact within all frozen budgets, regardless of whether every structural rule passes.
deterministic_scoring.aggregation: For each method report scheduled trial count, completion rate, structural-pass rate, and arithmetic mean structural fraction across all scheduled non-void trials. Failed/non-completing trials remain in denominators and contribute zero structural fraction. void_infrastructure records are reported separately and never silently removed.
deterministic_scoring.tie_breaking: No single winner is declared from a composite score; completion, deterministic structure, complexity and human perception remain separate result layers.

complexity_reporting.aggregation: Report per-trial raw values plus method median and arithmetic mean for token/tool/iteration/wall-time fields. Do not omit failed trials; unavailable provider metrics remain explicit nulls rather than guessed values.

perceptual_evaluation.vlm_judge: disabled; owner gate G4 remains unresolved and no VLM score enters B0-v1
perceptual_evaluation.blind_order: For each task, review artifacts are displayed without method names and ordered by ascending SHA-256 of '<task_id>|<trial_index>|<method_id>'.
perceptual_evaluation.scale: integer 1-5 per dimension, where 1 is poor and 5 is strong
perceptual_evaluation.rejection: The evaluator may mark human_rejection, but human scores never override deterministic structural facts.

human_intervention_policy.during_generation: No prompt edits, manual pixel edits, method-specific hints, selective reruns or early stopping based on appearance.
human_intervention_policy.after_generation: The owner may perform the frozen blind perceptual rating only; review does not mutate outputs.

artifact_retention.storage: Commit the complete sanitized scored evidence under evidence/b0/results/<freeze-commit>/<method>/<task>/<trial>/ or an equivalently immutable path. Authentication material and secrets are never retained.
artifact_retention.hashing: Attempt manifests record SHA-256 for retained byte artifacts and cite this preregistration freeze commit.
artifact_retention.unsuccessful_attempts: Retained with the same identity and failure category; never replaced by a later successful attempt.

execution_environment.portable_ci_role: CI may validate harness/schema/replay without provider/network access; scored provider runs are not portable-CI correctness gates.

immutability.scoring_start_condition: No B0 scored attempt may begin until the commit that first adds this exact file is merged to main and its commit SHA is recorded as the B0-F0 freeze commit.
immutability.after_first_scored_attempt: This cohort, task text, constraints, methods, settings, budgets, retry/exclusion rules, scoring and trial count are immutable. Any architecture improvement belongs after B0-P0 and may not be used to rerun or relabel this cohort.
immutability.held_out_boundary: B1 must use separately frozen held-out variants; B0 task outputs are development-visible evidence only.
